items.name: Date of Birth
items.meaning: The calendar date on which the person was born, in the local date of the place of birth. Time of birth is not recorded.
items.supplied_by: Applicant statement, verified against vital records or SSA data.

items.name: Determination Date
items.meaning: The date as of which eligibility is being determined. For an application it is the application date; for a renewal it is the redetermination date.

items.name: Is pregnant
items.meaning: The person is currently pregnant.

items.name: Is entitled to postpartum medical assistance
items.meaning: The person is entitled to postpartum medical assistance under section 1902(e)(5) or (e)(16) of the Social Security Act. Determined by the pregnancy-related eligibility determination, outside this volume.

items.name: Lives with
items.meaning: The persons in the case with whom this person primarily resides.

items.name: Relationships
items.meaning: For each other person in the case, how this person is related to them. A person may hold several relationships to the same person. "relative" means a relative by blood, adoption, or marriage not otherwise listed.

items.name: Persons cared for
items.meaning: The persons in the case to whom this person provides assistance that occurs on a regular basis and is not solely incidental in nature.

items.name: Care hours by person
items.meaning: For each person in Persons cared for, the hours of assistance this person provided to them in the month.

items.name: Relies on another individual for care
items.meaning: The person relies on another individual for care.

items.name: Is a disabled individual under the ADA
items.meaning: The person meets the Americans with Disabilities Act definition of disability at 28 CFR 35.108. The person need not be eligible for any program on the basis of disability.
items.supplied_by: Eligibility worker determination from documentation or statement.

items.name: Indian status
items.meaning: Whether the person is an Indian or Urban Indian as defined in 25 U.S.C. 1603(13) and (28), a California Indian described in 25 U.S.C. 1679(a), or has otherwise been determined eligible as an Indian for the Indian Health Service. "IHS-eligible only" means the last of these without the others.
items.supplied_by: Tribal enrollment or IHS eligibility documentation.

items.name: Is a veteran with a total disability rating
items.meaning: The person is a veteran with a disability rated as total under 38 U.S.C. 1155.
items.supplied_by: Department of Veterans Affairs rating documentation.

items.name: Is blind or disabled under SSA section 1614
items.meaning: The person is blind or disabled as defined in section 1614 of the Social Security Act.

items.name: Has a substance use disorder
items.meaning: The person has a substance use disorder.
items.supplied_by: Clinical documentation or statement under penalty of perjury, per verification rules.

items.name: Recovery start date
items.meaning: The date on which the person's recovery from a substance use disorder began. Unknown when the person is not in recovery.

items.name: Has a disabling mental disorder
items.meaning: The person has a disabling mental disorder.

items.name: Has a disability that significantly impairs daily activities
items.meaning: The person has a physical, intellectual, or developmental disability that significantly impairs their ability to perform one or more activities of daily living.

items.name: Has a serious or complex medical condition
items.meaning: The person has a medical condition that is life threatening, seriously disabling without necessarily being life threatening, causing significant pain or discomfort that can cause serious interruptions to life activities, requiring a major time or effort commitment from caregivers for a substantial period of time, requiring frequent monitoring, associated with severe consequences or negative consequences for someone else, affecting multiple organ systems, requiring management to tight physiological parameters, requiring coordination of multiple specialties, requiring treatment that carries a risk of serious complications, or requiring adjustment in non-medical environments.

items.name: Condition significantly impairs ability to comply
items.meaning: The person's physical, mental, or other behavioral health condition significantly impairs their ability to comply with the community engagement requirement.

items.name: Receives disability benefits
items.meaning: The person is receiving temporary or permanent disability benefits issued by governmental or private sources.
items.supplied_by: Benefit award documentation or data match.

items.name: Agency finds the person obviously unfit for employment
items.meaning: The State agency has determined that the person is obviously mentally or physically unfit for employment.

items.name: Has a medical statement of unfitness for employment
items.meaning: The person has provided a statement from a physician, physician's assistant, nurse, nurse practitioner, designated representative of the physician's office, a licensed or certified psychologist, a social worker, or other medical personnel the State agency determines appropriate, that they are physically or mentally unfit for employment.

items.name: Was an inmate of a public institution in month
items.meaning: At any point during the month the person was an inmate of a public institution.

items.name: Is complying with TANF work requirements
items.meaning: During the month the person is subject to and in compliance with work requirements imposed under title IV-A of the Social Security Act (TANF).

items.name: Receives unemployment compensation
items.meaning: During the month the person is subject to and complying with the work registration requirements of the Federal-State unemployment compensation system, shown by receipt of unemployment compensation.

items.name: Is a member of a household receiving SNAP
items.meaning: During the month the person is a member of a household that receives SNAP benefits.

items.name: Participates in a substance use treatment program
items.meaning: During the month the person is a regular participant in a drug addiction or alcoholic treatment and rehabilitation program as defined in section 3(h) of the Food and Nutrition Act of 2008.

items.name: Is eligible for or enrolled in the adult group
items.meaning: The person is eligible to enroll or is enrolled under the State plan in the adult group described in section 1902(a)(10)(A)(i)(VIII), determined outside this volume.

items.name: Is eligible for or enrolled under an equivalent-coverage waiver
items.meaning: The person is eligible to enroll or is enrolled under a section 1115 waiver providing coverage equivalent to minimum essential coverage.

items.name: Is entitled to or enrolled in Medicare
items.meaning: The person is entitled to or enrolled for Medicare Part A, or enrolled for Part B.

items.name: Is otherwise eligible under the State plan
items.meaning: The person is otherwise eligible to enroll under the State plan in a group other than the adult group.

items.name: Is in the former foster care youth group
items.meaning: The person is described in section 1902(a)(10)(A)(i)(IX), the group for former foster care children.

items.name: Hours worked
items.meaning: Hours of work performed in the month.
items.supplied_by: Payroll data match, employer verification, or statement.

items.name: Community service hours
items.meaning: Hours of community service completed in the month.

items.name: Work program hours
items.meaning: Hours of participation in a work program in the month, in compliance with the program's requirements.

items.name: Educational program hours
items.meaning: Hours of participation in an educational program in the month.

items.name: Is enrolled at least half-time in an educational program
items.meaning: During the month the person is enrolled at least half-time in a recognized school, training program, or institution of higher education.

items.name: Monthly income
items.meaning: The person's income for the month.

items.name: Is a seasonal worker
items.meaning: The person is a seasonal worker as described in section 45R(d)(5)(B) of the Internal Revenue Code.

items.name: Hours missed for good cause
items.meaning: Hours of work, work program, or workfare the person would have completed in the month but missed for good cause as determined by the State agency, where the absence was temporary.

items.name: Participates in workfare
items.meaning: During the month the person participates in and complies with a program under 7 U.S.C. 2029 or a comparable State or local program.

items.name: Received SNAP benefits for the full month
items.meaning: The person received SNAP benefits for the full benefit month.

items.name: SNAP benefits were prorated in month
items.meaning: The person's benefits for the month were prorated under 7 CFR 273.10.

items.name: Covered by an ABAWD waiver in month
items.meaning: During the month the person resided in an area covered by an approved waiver of the time limit.
items.supplied_by: Waiver geography lookup on the person's address.

items.name: Has a discretionary exemption in month
items.meaning: The State agency applied one of its discretionary exemptions to the person for the month.

items.name: SNAP household members
items.meaning: The persons in the case who are members of the same SNAP household as this person, determined under 7 CFR 273.1 outside this volume.

items.name: Has responsibility for the care of an incapacitated person
items.meaning: The person is responsible for the care of an incapacitated person.

items.name: Is head of household
items.meaning: The person is the head of the SNAP household.

items.name: Hours worked in the last 30 days
items.meaning: Hours worked during the 30-day period ending on the Determination Date.

items.name: Work program hours in the last 30 days
items.meaning: Hours of work program participation, in compliance with its requirements, during the 30-day period ending on the Determination Date.

items.name: Participated in workfare in the last 30 days
items.meaning: During the 30-day period ending on the Determination Date the person participated in and complied with a workfare program.

items.name: Received inpatient or facility services in month
items.meaning: For part or all of the month the person received inpatient hospital services, nursing facility services, services in an intermediate care facility for individuals with intellectual disabilities, inpatient psychiatric hospital services, or other services of similar acuity.

items.name: County has a declared emergency or disaster in month
items.meaning: For part or all of the month the county in which the person resides is under an emergency or disaster declared by the President under the National Emergencies Act or the Stafford Act.
items.supplied_by: Declaration lookup on the person's county.

items.name: County unemployment rate
items.meaning: The unemployment rate for the month of the county in which the person resides, as a fraction.
items.supplied_by: Bureau of Labor Statistics data on the person's county.

items.name: National unemployment rate
items.meaning: The national unemployment rate for the month, as a fraction.

items.name: Traveled outside the community for extended care in month
items.meaning: For part or all of the month the person or their dependent had to travel outside their community for an extended period to receive medical services necessary to treat a serious or complex medical condition that are not available within their community of residence.

items.name: Most recent eligibility determination date
items.meaning: The date of the person's most recent determination or redetermination of eligibility before the current one.

items.name: Medicaid community engagement required hours per month
items.meaning: The hours of work, community service, work program participation, or a combination that demonstrate community engagement for a month.

items.name: Federal minimum wage
items.meaning: The Federal minimum hourly wage under 29 U.S.C. 206(a)(1).

items.name: Medicaid community engagement minimum age
items.meaning: The youngest age at which a person can be an applicable individual. A person must have attained this age.

items.name: Medicaid community engagement age ceiling
items.meaning: A person must be under this age to be an applicable individual.

items.name: Medicaid dependent child maximum age
items.meaning: A dependent child for the caregiver exclusion is 13 years of age or under.

items.name: Medicaid application lookback months
items.meaning: The number of consecutive months immediately preceding the month of application for which an applicant must demonstrate community engagement. The State specifies 1, 2, or 3.
items.assumption: The State elects 1 month. Replace with the actual election.

items.name: Medicaid renewal required months
items.meaning: The number of months, consecutive or not, between determinations for which an enrollee must demonstrate community engagement. The State specifies 1 or more.
items.assumption: The State elects 1 month. Replace with the actual election.

items.name: Medicaid community engagement implementation date
items.meaning: The first date on which community engagement is a condition of eligibility in this State. The Federal deadline is January 1, 2027; the State may elect an earlier date or hold a good-faith exemption until December 31, 2028.
items.assumption: No earlier election and no good-faith exemption.

items.name: Stable recovery years
items.meaning: A person in recovery from a substance use disorder for this many years or more is in stable recovery and is not medically frail on that basis.

items.name: Inmate lookback months
items.meaning: The number of months before a month during which having been an inmate of a public institution excludes the person for that month.

items.name: Caregiver minimum hours, non-resident non-relative
items.meaning: The monthly hours of non-incidental assistance a person must provide to a dependent child or disabled individual with whom they neither reside nor are related, to be a family caregiver.

items.name: Hardship unemployment rate cap
items.meaning: The county unemployment rate at or above which a short-term hardship exists, unless 1.5 times the national rate is lower.

items.name: Hardship national rate multiplier
items.meaning: The multiple of the national unemployment rate compared against the cap.

items.name: State elects the short-term hardship exception
items.meaning: Whether the State has elected the optional short-term hardship exception.
items.assumption: The State elects the exception. Replace with the actual election.

items.name: Medicaid seasonal income averaging months
items.meaning: The number of preceding months over which a seasonal worker's income is averaged.

items.name: SNAP ABAWD minimum age
items.meaning: The youngest age subject to the ABAWD time limit. Persons under 18 are exempt.

items.name: SNAP ABAWD maximum age
items.meaning: The oldest age subject to the ABAWD time limit.
items.assumption: Persons 65 and older are exempt, matching the reported FNS implementation. The statute reads "over 65", which literally exempts only persons 66 and older.

items.name: SNAP dependent child age limit
items.meaning: A dependent child for the time-limit exception is under this age.

items.name: SNAP required hours per month
items.meaning: Twenty hours a week averaged monthly, which the regulation defines as 80 hours a month.

items.name: SNAP countable month limit
items.meaning: The number of countable months in the period after which the person is ineligible.

items.name: SNAP time limit period months
items.meaning: The length in months of the period over which countable months accumulate.

items.name: SNAP hours to regain eligibility
items.meaning: Hours of work or work program participation in a 30-day period that regain eligibility.

items.name: SNAP work registration minimum age
items.meaning: The youngest age subject to general work registration. The statute covers persons over 15.

items.name: SNAP work registration maximum age
items.meaning: The oldest age subject to general work registration. The statute covers persons under 60.

items.name: SNAP general exemption child age
items.meaning: Responsibility for a dependent child under this age exempts a person from general work registration.

items.name: SNAP employment exemption weekly hours
items.meaning: Weekly hours of employment, or the multiple of the minimum wage in weekly earnings, that exempt a person from general work registration.

items.name: SNAP time limit clock method
items.meaning: Whether the State measures the 36-month period as a rolling window ending at the current month or as a fixed period.
items.assumption: Rolling clock. Replace with the State's method.

items.name: SNAP ABAWD changes effective date
items.meaning: The date on which the Pub. L. 119-21 changes to the time-limit exceptions took effect.
items.assumption: Effective on enactment; section 10102 states no other date.

items.name: Age
items.meaning: Whole years elapsed from Date of Birth to the Determination Date.
items.precision: Day-based. A person turns N on the Nth anniversary of Date of Birth, starting at 12:00am local time. Time of birth is ignored. A February 29 birth turns N on March 1 in a non-leap year.

items.name: Age at month
items.meaning: Whole years elapsed from Date of Birth to the first day of the month.
items.precision: Same day-based rule as Age. A person who reaches an age during the month is treated as the younger age for that whole month.

items.name: Medicaid: is in the community engagement age range
items.meaning: The person has attained age 19 and is under age 65.

items.name: Medicaid: is a dependent child
items.meaning: The person is 13 years of age or under and relies on another individual for care.

items.name: Medicaid: is a dependent child or disabled individual
items.meaning: The person is a dependent child or a disabled individual, as those terms are defined for the community engagement subpart.

items.name: Medicaid: is a parent, guardian, or caretaker relative of a dependent
items.meaning: There is a person of whom this person is a parent, guardian, or caretaker relative, and that person is a dependent child or disabled individual.

items.name: Medicaid: is a family caregiver of a dependent
items.meaning: There is a person this person cares for who is a dependent child or disabled individual, and this person either resides with them, is their relative, or provided at least 80 hours of assistance to them in the month containing the Determination Date.
items.precision: Care hours are read from the month containing the Determination Date.

items.name: Medicaid: is in stable recovery
items.meaning: The person has been in recovery from a substance use disorder for 5 or more years as of the Determination Date. A person with no recovery start date is not in stable recovery.

items.name: Medicaid: is medically frail or has special medical needs
items.meaning: The person's condition significantly impairs their ability to comply, and the person is blind or disabled under SSA rules, has a substance use disorder and is not in stable recovery, has a disabling mental disorder, has a disability that significantly impairs daily activities, or has a serious or complex medical condition.

items.name: Medicaid: was an inmate within the lookback
items.meaning: In any of the 3 months before the month containing the Determination Date the person was an inmate of a public institution.
items.precision: The regulation's window ends on the first day of the month; an inmate stay that touches only the first day of the current month is not captured here.

items.name: Medicaid: is excluded by SNAP or TANF work requirement compliance
items.meaning: In the month containing the Determination Date the person is complying with TANF work requirements, or is a member of a household receiving SNAP and is subject to a SNAP work requirement.

items.name: Medicaid: is pregnant or postpartum
items.meaning: The person is pregnant or is entitled to postpartum medical assistance.

items.name: Medicaid: is excluded as an Indian
items.meaning: The person is an Indian, an Urban Indian, a California Indian, or has otherwise been determined eligible as an Indian for the Indian Health Service.

items.name: Medicaid: is a specified excluded individual
items.meaning: The person is in the former foster care youth group, is excluded as an Indian, is a parent, guardian, or caretaker relative of a dependent, is a family caregiver of a dependent, is a veteran with a total disability rating, is medically frail, is excluded by SNAP or TANF work requirement compliance, participates in a substance use treatment program in the month containing the Determination Date, was an inmate within the lookback, or is pregnant or postpartum.

items.name: Medicaid: is an applicable individual
items.meaning: The person is not a specified excluded individual, and either is eligible for or enrolled in the adult group, or is eligible for or enrolled under an equivalent-coverage waiver while in the age range, not pregnant, not entitled to or enrolled in Medicare, and not otherwise eligible under the State plan.

items.name: Medicaid: community engagement income threshold
items.meaning: The Federal minimum wage multiplied by the required hours per month.

items.name: Medicaid: countable educational program hours
items.meaning: Educational program hours that may be combined with other activities. When the person is enrolled at least half-time, no education hours are combined because half-time enrollment demonstrates community engagement on its own.

items.name: Medicaid: total qualifying hours
items.meaning: Hours worked plus community service hours plus work program hours plus countable educational program hours for the month. An activity with no reported hours counts as 0.

items.name: Medicaid: meets the hours condition
items.meaning: Total qualifying hours for the month are at least the required hours.

items.name: Medicaid: meets the income condition
items.meaning: Monthly income is at least the community engagement income threshold.

items.name: Medicaid: six-month average income
items.meaning: Monthly income averaged over the 6 months before the month.

items.name: Medicaid: meets the seasonal income condition
items.meaning: The person is a seasonal worker and their six-month average income is at least the income threshold.

items.name: Medicaid: demonstrates community engagement for month
items.meaning: For the month the person meets the hours condition, is enrolled at least half-time in an educational program, meets the income condition, or meets the seasonal income condition.

items.name: Medicaid: county unemployment meets the hardship threshold
items.meaning: The county unemployment rate is at or above the lesser of the cap and the multiplier times the national unemployment rate.

items.name: Medicaid: experiences a short-term hardship in month
items.meaning: The State elects the hardship exception, and for part or all of the month the person received inpatient or facility services, resided in a county with a declared emergency or disaster or with unemployment meeting the threshold, or traveled outside the community for extended care.

items.name: Medicaid: community engagement satisfied for month
items.meaning: For the month the person demonstrates community engagement or experiences a short-term hardship.

items.name: Medicaid: application lookback months
items.meaning: The consecutive months, as many as the State specifies, ending with the month before the month containing the Determination Date.

items.name: Medicaid: satisfies community engagement at application
items.meaning: Community engagement is satisfied in each of the application lookback months.

items.name: Medicaid: community engagement status at application
items.meaning: Not yet in effect when the Determination Date is before the implementation date; not subject when the person is not an applicable individual; met when community engagement is satisfied at application; otherwise not met.

items.name: Medicaid: renewal review months
items.meaning: The months after the month of the most recent determination and before the month containing the Determination Date.

items.name: Medicaid: months demonstrated since last determination
items.meaning: The number of renewal review months for which community engagement is satisfied.

items.name: Medicaid: satisfies community engagement at renewal
items.meaning: Months demonstrated since the last determination are at least the number the State requires.

items.name: Medicaid: community engagement status at renewal
items.meaning: Not yet in effect when the Determination Date is before the implementation date; not subject when the person is not an applicable individual; met when community engagement is satisfied at renewal; otherwise not met.

items.name: SNAP: is in the ABAWD age range
items.meaning: Age at the month is at least 18 and at most the ABAWD maximum age.

items.name: SNAP: is medically certified unfit for employment
items.meaning: The person receives disability benefits, the agency finds them obviously unfit, or they have a medical statement of unfitness.

items.name: SNAP: has responsibility for a dependent child under 14
items.meaning: There is a member of the person's SNAP household who is under 14 at the month and of whom this person is a parent or whom this person cares for.

items.name: SNAP: has responsibility for a dependent child under 6
items.meaning: There is a member of the person's SNAP household who is under 6 at the month and of whom this person is a parent or whom this person cares for.

items.name: SNAP: weekly average hours worked
items.meaning: Hours worked in the month converted to a weekly average, using 12 months per 52 weeks. No reported hours counts as 0.

items.name: SNAP: weekly earnings
items.meaning: Monthly income converted to weekly earnings, using 12 months per 52 weeks.

items.name: SNAP: meets the employment exemption
items.meaning: Weekly average hours worked are at least 30, or weekly earnings are at least the Federal minimum wage times 30.

items.name: SNAP: is exempt from general work registration
items.meaning: During the month the person is complying with TANF work requirements, receives unemployment compensation, has responsibility for a child under 6 or an incapacitated person, is enrolled at least half-time in an educational program, participates in a substance use treatment program, meets the employment exemption, or is 16 or 17 and either not head of household or enrolled at least half-time.

items.name: SNAP: is subject to general work registration
items.meaning: Age at the month is 16 through 59, the person is not unfit for employment, and the person is not exempt from general work registration.

items.name: SNAP: is exempt as an Indian
items.meaning: The person is an Indian, an Urban Indian, or a California Indian. Eligibility for the Indian Health Service alone does not qualify.

items.name: SNAP: is exempt from the ABAWD time limit
items.meaning: For the month the person is outside the ABAWD age range, is unfit for employment, has responsibility for a child under 14, is exempt from general work registration, is pregnant, or is exempt as an Indian.

items.name: SNAP: hours worked including good cause
items.meaning: Hours worked plus hours missed for good cause in the month. No reported hours counts as 0.

items.name: SNAP: fulfills the work requirement for month
items.meaning: For the month hours worked including good cause are at least 80, work program hours are at least 80, or the person participates in workfare.

items.name: SNAP: is a countable month
items.meaning: The person received SNAP benefits for the full month, the benefits were not prorated, and the person was not exempt from the time limit, not covered by a waiver, not fulfilling the work requirement, and not given a discretionary exemption.

items.name: SNAP: time limit period months
items.meaning: The 36 consecutive months ending with the month before the month containing the Determination Date.
items.precision: Rolling clock. A fixed clock would replace this derivation.

items.name: SNAP: countable months used
items.meaning: The number of months in the time limit period that are countable months.

items.name: SNAP: has exhausted the time limit
items.meaning: Countable months used are at least 3.

items.name: SNAP: regains eligibility
items.meaning: In the 30 days ending on the Determination Date the person worked at least 80 hours, participated in a work program for at least 80 hours, or participated in workfare.

items.name: SNAP: time limit status
items.meaning: Prior law applies when the Determination Date is before the effective date of the changes; not subject when the person is exempt in the month containing the Determination Date; within limit when the time limit is not exhausted; regained when it is exhausted but the person regains eligibility; otherwise limit exhausted.

items.name: SNAP: is subject to a SNAP work requirement
items.meaning: For the month the person is subject to general work registration or is not exempt from the ABAWD time limit.

meta.title: Work requirements under H.R.1, Medicaid community engagement and the SNAP ABAWD time limit
meta.status: Draft. AI first pass. Nothing in this volume is approved.
